reason: 2026-09-20: Deliver the account session cookie. Neon functions serialize only the last Set-Cookie header, so withAccountCookies has been shipping the CSRF cookie and silently dropping __Host-pack1_account since the first-party cutover: every sign-in reports success, the UI reads the CSRF cookie and believes it, and every authenticated request then 401s. Verified against the deployed development function, and the runtime behaviour was confirmed with a throwaway probe. The worker now writes one joined Set-Cookie header and the gateway splits it back into separate headers, which is the only shape that survives. Functions deploy before the gateway in this workflow, so multi-cookie responses are malformed for the few minutes in between; those same responses are already broken today and single-cookie responses are unaffected. Accepted deliberately in favour of one release.
